title: Durango-La Plata County Airport (DRO)
claims: DRO is the primary regional airport for southwest Colorado, northwest New Mexico and the Four Corners region.
DRO is served by American Airlines and United Airlines.
Year-round daily nonstop service is available to Dallas-Fort Worth, Denver and Phoenix, with seasonal nonstop service to Houston.
Long-term parking is a few steps from the terminal.
The airport offers rental cars and ground transportation information.
